description: Verify that the Type 2 entry Service ID of the SubscribeAck/Nack is configured SdServerServiceID
approach:
[Objective]
This case asserts a single SOME/IP-SD wire-format invariant: Type 2 entry Service ID must equal configured SdServerServiceID. The harness drives DUT to emit a qualifying SubscribeAck/Nack, captures it, and validates the field byte-precisely.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester drives DUT to emit a SubscribeAck/Nack (typically by completing OfferService prelude or sending a stimulus message).
2. Observation: captured SubscribeAck/Nack's Type 2 entry Service ID == configured SdServerServiceID   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Type 2 entry Service ID on the wire equals configured SdServerServiceID.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_service_id — Entry service_id mismatch
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a qualifying SubscribeAck/Nack within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted Type 2 entry Service ID == configured SdServerServiceID — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying SubscribeAck/Nack within listen window
